name: dev-dashboard
description: A right-hand sidebar of this session: files edited, recent commands, checks and denials, as a menu of tabs

autoOpen.title: Open the sidebar by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the dashboard on the right when the screen is wide enough (it still hides on a narrow screen and comes back when it widens)

minColumns.title: Hide below this many columns
minColumns.description: The sidebar hides itself when the terminal is narrower than this, or not in the fullscreen layout

sidebarColumns.title: Sidebar width
sidebarColumns.description: Columns the sidebar asks for; 0 = about 28% of the screen, between 34 and 48
